title: County auditor search process
summary: The Independent Nomination Board heard an explanation of the County Auditor search in October 2024 and said it may invite the personnel services director in January. A discussion of the county auditor process was planned for December 4.

timeline.text: A discussion of the county auditor process is planned for December 4.
Members may invite the personnel services director to a meeting in January to discuss the auditor search.
